column2: A grave kerb - poured concrete edging, not a headstone - with the surname cut into its face in inset lettering
*** LERENA *** - and nothing else. No forename. No dates. No epitaph.
Bare earth and grass. No stone, no slab, no plate. Whatever marked the plot is gone, or was never there.
Maitland, Woltemade Cemetery, Cape Town, Western Cape
